game.title: Batman: Arkham City
game.blurb: Open-world action-adventure in which Batman takes on the villains of Arkham City, from Rocksteady Studios, released 2011-10-18. RAWG average playtime: 20 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Batman inside the walls of Arkham City, from becoming the Bat to the final act. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Side Missions
chapters.summary: Assaults, a serial killer, a phone booth killer, a contract operative, a mystery watcher, Calendar Man and other optional cases.

chapters.title: The Riddler's Challenges
chapters.summary: Solving riddles and rescuing the Riddler's hostages one by one.

chapters.title: Catwoman (likely)
chapters.summary: A short block of achievements about stealing a score and getting stolen goods back, plus the Catwoman riddle grid and medals. Placed partly by position in the list.

chapters.title: Challenge Maps, AR Training and Combat
chapters.summary: Augmented reality training, medals on the challenge maps and campaigns (Batman, Robin and Nightwing), and freeflow combat tricks.

chapters.title: Harley Quinn's Revenge
chapters.summary: The add-on story named in the achievement list: the Dry Docks, a secret base, bombs and balloons. Placed partly by position in the list.

chapters.title: New Game Plus and 100 Percent
chapters.summary: All gadgets and upgrades, New Game Plus and completing every challenge.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 200260)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Batman:_Arkham_City
Fandom (arkhamcity.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://arkhamcity.fandom.com/wiki/Batman:_Arkham_City
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 1. Its walkthrough lists a Prologue, "Becoming the Bat" and 12 side missions, but only the Prologue and "Becoming the Bat" are written (plus Achievements and trophies, Controls, Gadgets and Batsuit, and Gameplay), so it was not used. arkhamcity.fandom.com answers the API, with about 228 linked pages (including "Harley Quinn's Revenge", "Catwoman Bundle", "Challenge Maps" and "Batman: Arkham City Riddler Challenges"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The only Steam app in the store list is the Game of the Year Edition (200260); its schema gives no game name. RAWG's first result is the base game (28623, batman-arkham-city-2), as expected; RAWG also has a separate GOTY entry (17576). None of the 64 Steam achievements is hidden, but most story ones have cryptic one-line descriptions, so the main story, side mission, Catwoman and Harley Quinn's Revenge chapters are placed by name lists, using list position and unlock rates (14 story-looking achievements at the top, unlocked by 41 to 83 percent of players). Only "A Few New Tricks" names Harley Quinn's Revenge, and none of the three Catwoman story achievements names Catwoman; both blocks are inferred from position and need checking. "Broken Toys", "Stop the Clock", "Bargaining Chip" and "Pay Your Respects" are guessed to be side content.
